blocks.text: Updated at 9:30 p.m. on October 22, 2026 MANILA, Philippines — The national government’s budget deficit exceeded its nine-month program by more than P97 billion, even as the fiscal gap stayed nearly flat in September, because higher spending continued to outpace revenue collections for the year. Latest data from the Bureau of the Treasury showed the September shortfall rose by just 0.33 percent to P248.9 billion from P248.1 billion a year earlier, with stronger revenue collections largely keeping pace with the increase in expenditures.
